subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should PluginHookAgentContext permanently expose a current-session-only resetSession(reason?) capability for successful after-compaction hooks across OpenClaw, Codex, and bundled Copilot lifecycles?
rationale: This is a new external hook capability with session-destruction semantics and cross-runtime availability rules; code correctness alone cannot establish whether that is the intended long-term plugin contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook contract
options.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred API after the unconditional tool-loop abort is fixed and real post-reset continuation proof is added.

options.title: Keep reset authority internal
options.body: Remove the public hook-context API and expose an owner-specific internal compaction recovery seam instead.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or substantially rework the PR until a smaller lifecycle contract can solve the observed compaction loop without new plugin API surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred API after the unconditional tool-loop abort is fixed and real post-reset continuation proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core plugin API policy and Gateway session lifecycle rather than one provider implementation.
